biography: I'm an Applied AI Engineer based in Mumbai. My work sits where language models meet real business data: financial and HR documents, internal knowledge, and the backend services that connect them.

My documented experience spans two roles: a Machine Learning Intern at Supermoney Advisors Private Limited (August 2024 – July 2025), where I built conversational AI services, and my current role as Data Scientist & AI Engineer at JHS & Associates LLP (July 2025 – Present), where I work on document intelligence, workflow automation and FastAPI backend projects.
Across both roles the recurring themes are Retrieval-Augmented Generation, hybrid OCR and LLM pipelines, structured data extraction, and Python backend development with FastAPI and MongoDB.

responsibilities.text: Developed a hybrid OCR and LLM-based invoice classification pipeline using Surya OCR and local Qwen2.5, with OpenAI API fallback to support document processing and improve output stability.

Automated payroll review and spreadsheet reconciliation workflows using Python, Pandas, and an OPE approval PDF export system.
Developed a Compliance Signals Intelligence tool using FastAPI, MongoDB, and GPT-4o to identify and surface risk signals from business documents.
Worked on an LLM-based document validation system with pluggable model providers, including Hugging Face and Groq.
Authored technical build documentation for a Vendor Payment Management System covering 9 modules and 14 MongoDB schemas.
Developed a document automation workflow that extracts details from expense sheets using AI and OCR.
Developed a financial statement extraction pipeline using pdfplumber to support structured extraction from PDF documents.
